translations.literal: Once Wenzhou is lost there is not an inch of land to the north; inland trade will be coerced, Vietnam will no longer exist—how can Guangdong be preserved?
translations.idiomatic: Lose Wenzhou and there is no buffer to the north; inland trade will be squeezed, Vietnam will be gone—how then can Guangdong be saved?

sentences.zh: 害二。」

translations.literal: The second harm."
translations.idiomatic: That is the second harm."

sentences.zh: 疏入，不省。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, it received no attention.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial reached the throne but drew no response.

sentences.zh: 十二年，法人別遣狄隆、狄塞爾來會。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the French separately sent Dillon and Descours to meet.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the French sent Dillon and Descours to negotiate in Bourée's place.

sentences.zh: 適法官達魯倪思海至者蘭，為越人擊殺。

translations.literal: Just then the French judge Daru, who had reached Zhe'erlan, was killed by Vietnamese.
translations.idiomatic: A French judge named Daru had just reached Zhe'erlan when Vietnamese killed him.

sentences.zh: 狄使懼，又恥而諱其事，堅請按圖畫界，朝旨報可。

translations.literal: The Dillon envoys were afraid and, ashamed, concealed the matter; they firmly requested demarcation according to maps, and the court approved.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys were frightened and, ashamed of the incident, concealed it; they pressed for demarcation by map, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 於是首議江平、黃竹、白龍尾各地割隸越。

translations.literal: Thereupon they first proposed ceding Jiangping, Huangzhu, Bailongwei, and other places to Vietnam.
translations.idiomatic: They then proposed ceding Jiangping, Huangzhu, Bailongwei, and other districts to Vietnam.

sentences.zh: 承修指圖籍抗爭，狄使不能屈，欲分白龍尾半之左歸我而右歸越。

translations.literal: Chengxiu cited maps and records and resisted; the Dillon envoys could not overcome him and proposed dividing Bailongwei, the left half to us and the right to Vietnam.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxiu cited maps and records and held firm; unable to prevail, the envoys proposed splitting Bailongwei, the left half to China and the right to Vietnam.

sentences.zh: 承修以其地為欽海外戶，法得之則內偪防城，外斷東興、思勒，是無欽、廉也。

translations.literal: Chengxiu said the place was Qinzhou's outer gateway to the sea; if France obtained it they would press inward on Fangcheng and cut off Dongxing and Sile outward—Qin and Lian prefectures would be lost.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxiu argued that the district was Qinzhou's maritime gateway: in French hands it would threaten Fangcheng inland and sever Dongxing and Sile seaward—Qin and Lian would be lost.

sentences.zh: 議久之，暫與定約三條，猶未決，而狄使竟以兵力驅江平、黃竹居民內徙。

translations.literal: After long negotiation they provisionally agreed on three articles, yet matters were still unsettled, when the Dillon envoys used force to drive the residents of Jiangping and Huangzhu to move inland.
translations.idiomatic: Talks dragged on until three provisional articles were agreed, but before matters were settled the envoys used troops to drive the people of Jiangping and Huangzhu inland.

sentences.zh: 朝廷慮啟邊釁，命先勘欽西至桂省全界，承修遂與訂定清約，語詳邦交志。

translations.literal: The court, fearing a border clash, ordered survey of the full boundary from Qinzhou west to Guangxi; Chengxiu then concluded the definitive agreement, the details of which are given in the record of foreign relations.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing a border clash, the court ordered a survey of the full boundary from Qinzhou west through Guangxi; Chengxiu then signed the definitive agreement, described in detail in the treatises on foreign relations.

sentences.zh: 十三年，具約本末以上，复官。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he submitted a full account of the treaty from beginning to end and was restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he reported the full story of the treaty to the throne and was restored to rank.

sentences.zh: 十四年，謝病歸，主講豐湖書院，讀書養母。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he resigned on grounds of illness, became head lecturer at Fenghu Academy, and devoted himself to study while caring for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he retired on grounds of illness, took charge of Fenghu Academy, and devoted himself to study while supporting his mother.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒於惠州。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died at Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He died at Huizhou in the seventeenth year.

sentences.zh: 徐致祥，字季和，江蘇嘉定人。

translations.literal: Xu Zhixiang, courtesy name Jihe, was a native of Jiading in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zhixiang, whose courtesy name was Jihe, came from Jiading in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng he became a jinshi, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed an editor.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Xianfeng 10, entered the Hanlin as a bachelor, and was appointed editor.

sentences.zh: 晉中允，典試山東。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Junior Mentor and presided over the Shandong provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to Junior Mentor, he served as chief examiner for Shandong's provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 累遷內閣學士，督順天學政。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Grand Secretary and appointed educational commissioner of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Grand Secretary and was appointed educational commissioner of the capital district.

sentences.zh: 遭憂去，服闋，起故官。

translations.literal: He left office on bereavement; when mourning ended he resumed his former post.
translations.idiomatic: After his father's death he left office; when mourning ended he returned to his former post.

sentences.zh: 光緒十年，法越構兵，德璀琳以和議進，朝旨未決。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Guangxu, when France and Vietnam were at war, Detring advanced a peace proposal, but the court had not decided.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 10, as France and Vietnam went to war, Detring urged peace talks, but the court had not yet decided.

sentences.zh: 致祥上三策，謂：決戰宜速，任將宜專，軍勢宜聯。

translations.literal: Zhixiang submitted three policies, saying: decisive battle should be swift, commanders should have full authority, and military forces should be coordinated.
translations.idiomatic: Zhixiang proposed three policies: fight decisively and at once, give commanders full authority, and coordinate all forces.

sentences.zh: 閩事棘，言何璟、張兆棟無幹濟才，而薦楊岳斌、張佩綸堪重任，頗嘉納。

translations.literal: When Fujian affairs grew critical he said He Jing and Zhang Zhaodong lacked capacity for great undertakings, and recommended Yang Yuebin and Zhang Peilun as fit for heavy responsibility; this was largely commended and accepted.
translations.idiomatic: As the Fujian crisis worsened he declared He Jing and Zhang Zhaodong incapable of decisive action and recommended Yang Yuebin and Zhang Peilun for major commands—proposals largely accepted by the throne.

sentences.zh: 時議築鐵路，致祥聞而惡之，痛陳八害，並請力辟邪說，亟修河工，上責其誕妄，鐫三級。

translations.literal: When railways were under discussion Zhixiang heard of it with disgust, bitterly set forth eight harms, and also requested forceful rejection of heterodox doctrines and urgent repair of river works; the throne rebuked him for wild absurdity and demoted him three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: When railways were debated he reacted with revulsion, memorializing eight grave harms and urging rejection of the scheme and priority for river works; the emperor called his arguments absurd and demoted him three ranks.

sentences.zh: 越二年，鐵路議再起，又再阻止之。

translations.literal: Two years later the railway proposal arose again, and he blocked it once more.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later, when railways were debated again, he blocked the plan a second time.

sentences.zh: 先後封事十數上，而惓惓於抑奄寺，治河工，為時論所美。

translations.literal: In all he submitted more than ten sealed memorials, earnestly pressing suppression of eunuchs and repair of river works, and was praised by contemporary opinion.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted more than ten sealed memorials in all, persistently urging restraint on eunuchs and repair of the rivers—conduct praised by public opinion.

sentences.zh: 歷典福建、廣東鄉試。

translations.literal: He successively presided over the provincial examinations of Fujian and Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as chief examiner for the Fujian and Guangdong provincial examinations.

sentences.zh: 十八年，授大理寺卿，連劾樞臣禮親王世鐸、山西巡撫阿克達春，而糾彈張之洞尤不遺馀力。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was appointed President of the Court of Judicial Review and in succession impeached Grand Councilor Prince Li Shiduo and Shanxi Governor Akedachun, while attacking Zhang Zhidong with especial vigor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he became President of the Court of Judicial Review, impeaching in succession Grand Councilor Prince Li Shiduo and Shanxi Governor Akedachun, while attacking Zhang Zhidong with relentless energy.

sentences.zh: 尋命視學浙江，有嚴名。

translations.literal: Soon after he was ordered to inspect education in Zhejiang and gained a reputation for severity.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed to inspect education in Zhejiang, where he earned a reputation for strictness.

sentences.zh: 中日之役，我師敗績，上奕劻、李鴻章誤國狀，請逮葉志超、衛汝貴等寘之法，而畀馮子材、劉永福以征討名號，庶可振國威、作士氣。

translations.literal: In the Sino-Japanese War, when our forces suffered defeat, he memorialized the errors of Yikuang and Li Hongzhang that harmed the state, requested arrest and punishment of Ye Zhichao, Wei Rugui, and others, and urged entrusting Feng Zicai and Liu Yongfu with titles for campaign and suppression, so that national prestige might be revived and morale raised.
translations.idiomatic: After China's defeat in the Sino-Japanese War he denounced Yikuang and Li Hongzhang for betraying the nation, urged that Ye Zhichao, Wei Rugui, and others be arrested and punished, and proposed giving Feng Zicai and Liu Yongfu formal command to restore national prestige and revive army morale.

sentences.zh: 會山東教案起，德使海靖勒罷李秉衡職。

translations.literal: When the Shandong missionary case arose, the German envoy Heinig pressed for dismissal of Li Bingheng from office.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shandong missionary case broke out, the German envoy Heinig demanded that Li Bingheng be removed from office.

sentences.zh: 致祥曰：「昔歲罷劉秉璋，今茲罷李秉衡，是朝廷黜陟之大權操之敵人也。

translations.literal: Zhixiang said: "Last year Liu Bingzhang was dismissed; this year Li Bingheng is dismissed—thus the great power of promotion and demotion at court is wielded by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Zhixiang wrote: "Last year Liu Bingzhang was dismissed; this year Li Bingheng—the court's power over appointments is being exercised by a foreign power.

sentences.zh: 為請顧全國體，毋懾敵。」

translations.literal: I beg that national dignity be preserved and that we not fear the enemy."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that national dignity be preserved and that we not yield to intimidation."

sentences.zh: 私念國是不振，亂未有已，乃援引聖祖篤信硃子垂為家法往事，請舉行經筵以輔聖德，皆不報。

translations.literal: Privately he reflected that the nation's course was not being righted and disorder had no end; he therefore cited the precedent of the sage ancestor's devoted faith in Zhu Xi as a household law and requested regular lectures on the classics to assist sagely virtue—all without response.
translations.idiomatic: Privately he felt the nation's course was not being righted and turmoil would not end; citing the Kangxi emperor's devotion to Zhu Xi as dynastic precedent, he urged regular classical lectures to cultivate the sovereign's virtue—all without response.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，還朝，遷兵部右侍郎。

translations.literal: When his term expired he returned to court and was transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: When his term expired he returned to Beijing and was appointed Right Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，上違豫，眾情驚疑，復以輔導君德之說進。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the emperor fell ill and public sentiment was alarmed and doubtful; he again advanced the proposal to guide the sovereign's virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, when the emperor fell ill and public anxiety mounted, he again urged measures to cultivate the sovereign's virtue.

sentences.zh: 是時國家多故，聖嗣尚虛，致祥為重國本計，略言：「昔宋真宗取宗室子養之宮中，逮仁宗既生，即遣歸邸；

translations.literal: At this time the state had many troubles and the imperial heir was still unsettled; Zhixiang, weighing the foundation of the state, stated in brief: "Formerly Song Zhenzong took sons of the imperial clan and reared them in the palace; when Renzong was born they were sent back to their residences;
translations.idiomatic: The state faced many crises and the succession remained unsettled; Zhixiang, concerned for the dynastic foundation, wrote in summary: "Song Zhenzong once took imperial clansmen's sons into the palace to rear; when Renzong was born they were sent home;

sentences.zh: 厥後仁宗、高宗、理宗皆踵行之。

translations.literal: thereafter Renzong, Gaozong, and Lizong all followed this practice.
translations.idiomatic: later Renzong, Gaozong, and Lizong all followed the same practice.

sentences.zh: 有子而遣養子歸邸者，真宗是也。

translations.literal: The case of sending the foster son home when a son was born was Zhenzong's.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzong was the ruler who sent foster sons home once a natural son was born.

sentences.zh: 無子而即以養子傳授神器者，仁宗之於英宗，高宗之於孝宗，理宗之於度宗是也。

translations.literal: The cases of passing the sacred vessel directly to a foster son when there was no son were Renzong to Yingzong, Gaozong to Xiaozong, and Lizong to Duzong.
translations.idiomatic: When no natural son existed, foster sons received the throne: Renzong to Yingzong, Gaozong to Xiaozong, and Lizong to Duzong.

sentences.zh: 今以宗社系託之重，臣民屬望之切，深維至計，取則前朝，慎選近支宗室兄弟之子數人，擇親擇賢，入侍禁中，止以為子，不以為儲，恪遵家法，既可默察其賢否，徐以俟皇子之生。

translations.literal: Now, given the weight of entrusting altar and state and the urgency of officials' and people's hopes, deeply weighing the supreme plan and taking the former dynasty as model, carefully select several sons of brothers among the near branches of the imperial clan, choosing by kinship and choosing by worth, to attend within the forbidden precincts—only as sons, not as heirs apparent—strictly following household law, so that their worth may be quietly observed while awaiting the birth of an imperial son in due time.
translations.idiomatic: Given the weight of the succession and the people's urgent hopes, I urge that we follow the Song precedent: carefully select several sons of brothers from the near imperial clan, chosen for kinship and merit, to attend within the palace as foster sons but not as designated heirs, observing household law so their character may be quietly tested while awaiting the birth of an imperial son.

sentences.zh: 則皇上未有子而有子，皇太后未有孫而有孫，而穆宗付託之大業，亦繼承有屬矣。」

translations.literal: Then though the emperor has no son he will have a son, though the empress dowager has no grandson she will have a grandson, and the great enterprise entrusted by Muzong will also have one to inherit it."
translations.idiomatic: Then though the emperor has no son he will have sons in waiting, though the empress dowager has no grandson she will have grandsons in prospect, and the great charge entrusted by Tongzhi will have a line of succession."

sentences.zh: 乃未幾，果有立溥俊為大阿哥事。

translations.literal: Before long, indeed, there came the affair of establishing Pujun as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, the court did establish Pujun as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-fifth year.

sentences.zh: 論曰：體芳、寶廷、佩綸與張之洞，時稱翰林四諫，有大政事，必具疏論是非，與同時好言事者，又號「清流黨」。

translations.literal: The appraisal states: Tifang, Baoting, Peilun, and Zhang Zhidong were at the time called the Four Remonstrating Hanlin; on great affairs of state they invariably submitted memorials debating right and wrong, and together with contemporaries fond of speaking on affairs were also styled the Qingliu Party.
translations.idiomatic: The historians comment: Tifang, Baoting, Peilun, and Zhang Zhidong were known as the Four Remonstrating Hanlin; on major state affairs they invariably memorialized the throne on right and wrong, and together with like-minded contemporaries were called the Qingliu Party.

sentences.zh: 然體芳、寶廷議承大統，惓惓忠愛，非佩綸等所能及也。

translations.literal: Yet Tifang and Baoting in debating succession to the great line showed earnest loyal devotion beyond what Peilun and others could match.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in debating the imperial succession Tifang and Baoting showed a loyal devotion that Peilun and the others could not equal.

sentences.zh: 承修以搏擊為能，致祥以誕妄受責，君子譏之。

translations.literal: Chengxiu made fierce attack his talent; Zhixiang was punished for wild absurdity—men of principle ridiculed them.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxiu made a career of fierce denunciation; Zhixiang was punished for absurd arguments—thoughtful men held both in low regard.

sentences.zh: 唯盛昱言不妄發，潔身早退，庶超然無負清譽歟？

translations.literal: Only Sheng Yu did not speak rashly and purified himself by early retirement—perhaps he alone, detached, did not betray his pure reputation?
translations.idiomatic: Only Sheng Yu spoke with restraint and withdrew early to preserve his integrity—perhaps he alone, standing apart, did not betray the reputation of the Qingliu?
